desc:
❕LIKE THE GAME FOR MORE UPDATES❕
Gorilla game is a scary horror survival game set in the dark Backrooms. One player is the monster. Everyone else is a gilla trying to escape the lab experiment until time runs out. Gorilla Tag fans, welcome.

HOW IT WORKS
Vote for a map in the lobby. The monster is random, and your odds rise each game you aren't picked. Gillas get a head start, then the monster is released. If it catches you, it tears you apart. Sometimes all gillas glow through walls.

CONTROLS
Move: WASD or stick. Jump: Space or A.
Run into a wall to climb, jump at ledges to vault, jump off walls to wall jump.
Monster: run into a gilla to grab it, click/tap to rip off a limb. Right-click, Q or B lets go.
PC, mobile, console, VR.

LOBBY
Hat Shop: buy hats with Robux, yours for good.
Gilla Lab: change color and hats.
Increase Chance: be the monster more.
Pay to Join: join a hunt in progress.

Tags: Horror, Scary, Monster, Lab, Backrooms, Experiment, Survival, Escape, Gorilla Tag, Gila
